Popover.description: A popover on UI SDK: a small panel beside its trigger; Escape and an outside press close it, and focus returns to the trigger.

Root.description: Holds the open state; it renders no element of its own.

open.description: Controls the open state; pair it with onOpenChange.

defaultOpen.description: Opens the popover on first render when the state is not controlled.

onOpenChange.description: Called with the next open state whenever the popover asks to open or close.

modal.description: false: the page stays usable. true: focus is trapped, scroll locked and the page inert. Default false.

Trigger.description: The button that opens the popover; it renders a kit Button.

variant.description: The Button variant; unset, it is the Button default, secondary.

size.description: The Button size; unset, it is the Button default, m.

Popup.description: The panel, in the browser's top layer while open; it opens below the trigger and flips when there is no room.

container.description: The element, or a ref to it, the panel mounts into instead of in place. It still opens in the top layer.

side.description: The trigger's side the panel opens on; unset, bottom. It flips when there is no room.

align.description: The panel's alignment along that side; unset, center.

sideOffset.description: Extra px on top of the kit's CSS offset between the trigger and the panel.

collisionPadding.description: Kit-set: the 8px gap the panel keeps from the window's edges, the Dialog's gutter.

Title.description: The heading that names the popover; UI SDK points the panel's aria-labelledby at it.

Description.description: The supporting text; UI SDK points the panel's aria-describedby at it.

Close.description: A button that closes the popover; it renders a kit Button unless render gives another element.

variant.description: The Button variant; unset, it is the Button default, secondary.

size.description: The Button size; unset, it is the Button default, m.

render.description: Another element to close with, in place of the kit Button.

useWhen: A small task or a few details beside the control that opens them: edit a note, share, set a filter.
The page behind should stay usable while it is open.

avoidWhen.text: The person must answer before going on.
A short label that names or hints at a control; it holds nothing to press.
A list of options to choose one from.

a11y: Give every Popover.Popup a Popover.Title; it is the panel's accessible name.
Offer a visible way out: a Popover.Close inside the panel.
The Trigger needs a visible name or an aria-label; the panel does not name it.
